notes: Khmer is substring-matched, so the bare noun ពន្ធ was dropped because it hides inside ពន្ធនាគារ (prison); tax senses are carried by compounds (ពន្ធនាំចូល, ពន្ធគយ, អត្រាពន្ធ). បញ្ជា was dropped because it hides inside the very common បញ្ជាក់ (to confirm), replaced by ចេញបញ្ជា / បញ្ជាឱ្យ; ធានា alone was dropped because it hides inside ធានារ៉ាប់រង (insurance). Nothing here is a substring of the decoys សភាព or ប្រជាជន. My confidence in Khmer register is moderate: the legal-instrument nouns (អនុក្រឹត្យ, ប្រកាស, សារាចរ, រាជកិច្ច) are certain, but a few of the price-control phrasings may be more formal than daily press usage.
